Package com.example.lotterize.ui.addEvents

Class NewEventFragment

Fragment
com.example.lotterize.ui.addEvents.NewEventFragment
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChooseEventFiltersFragment.ChooseEventFiltersDialogListener
public class NewEventFragment extends Fragment implements ChooseEventFiltersFragment.ChooseEventFiltersDialogListener
NewEventFragment handles the creation of new events within the Lotterize app. This fragment provides a user interface for event organizers to input event details, select an optional image, validate input fields, and submit the event to Firebase Firestore. It also updates the current user's owned event list upon successful creation. The fragment uses the
invalid reference 
FragmentNewEventBinding
class for view binding, and integrates with
invalid reference 
FirebaseFirestore
for persistent data storage.
